scope: Actual staged standalone suite with portable broker, real PowerShell temporary-profile wrappers and the native ConPTY fixture using raw TTY input. Predates MCP probe ownership. No installed UI/provider-shell or production Tauri bootstrap claim.

assertions.fullName: actual staged standalone terminal owner spawns the owning Node fixture, resizes, reattaches, buffers, guards stale kills and joins native exit
assertions.title: spawns the owning Node fixture, resizes, reattaches, buffers, guards stale kills and joins native exit

assertions.fullName: portable loopback secret broker ownership coalesces binds and keeps different listener generations and sources isolated
assertions.title: coalesces binds and keeps different listener generations and sources isolated

assertions.fullName: portable loopback secret broker ownership copies session scope, quotes values, filters invalid names and revokes tokens
assertions.title: copies session scope, quotes values, filters invalid names and revokes tokens

assertions.fullName: portable loopback secret broker ownership rejects unauthenticated and unsupported requests before source reads and redacts errors
assertions.title: rejects unauthenticated and unsupported requests before source reads and redacts errors

assertions.fullName: portable loopback secret broker ownership closes an in-flight bind before reporting shutdown complete
assertions.title: closes an in-flight bind before reporting shutdown complete

assertions.fullName: portable loopback secret broker ownership destroys a partial HTTP connection without allowing a late database read
assertions.title: destroys a partial HTTP connection without allowing a late database read

assertions.fullName: portable loopback secret broker ownership retains the real native-close acknowledgement through a bounded timeout and retry
assertions.title: retains the real native-close acknowledgement through a bounded timeout and retry

assertions.title: retains ownership after a native-close failure and retries the same listener

assertions.fullName: portable loopback secret broker ownership redacts bind errors and can still join the failed listener
assertions.title: redacts bind errors and can still join the failed listener

assertions.fullName: portable loopback secret broker ownership rejects invalid deadlines without closing a live owner
assertions.title: rejects invalid deadlines without closing a live owner
